D: A young lion prince runs from his kingdom after his father's death and has to come back to claim it.
P: Serve the snacks when Timon and Pumbaa teach Simba to eat grubs.
S: Timon and Pumbaa showing Simba the grubs
Rice noodles fried at 190C until they puff into crunchy grubs, tossed with chilli salt and lime, piled on a leaf.
Rockmelon, papaya, mango and passionfruit cut into wedges, with lime and a sprinkle of chilli salt.
Pride Rock beef samosas with mint yoghurt

Spiced beef mince with onion, peas and garam masala folded into pastry triangles, fried until crisp, with mint yoghurt. Fry 1 diced onion in oil until soft, add 400g beef mince, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp cumin and 2 grated garlic cloves and cook 8 minutes. Stir in 1 cup frozen peas and season, then cool. Cut 6 sheets spring roll pastry into 3 long strips each, fold a spoonful of filling into triangles and seal with flour paste. Fry at 180C for 3 minutes until crisp. Stir chopped mint and a squeeze of lemon into 200g Greek yoghurt for dipping.
M: Pride Lands braai rump with pap and relish
the open savannah of the Pride Lands

Beef rump steaks rubbed with paprika, coriander and garlic, grilled over coals, sliced with pap and a tomato and onion relish. Rub 800g rump steak with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp ground coriander, 2 crushed garlic cloves, oil and salt and stand 30 minutes. For the relish, fry 2 sliced onions until soft, add 4 chopped tomatoes and a pinch of chilli and simmer 15 minutes. Whisk 250g white maize meal into 1L salted boiling water and stir over low heat for 20 minutes until thick, then beat in 30g butter. Grill the steak over hot coals 4 minutes a side, rest 5 minutes and slice over the pap with relish.
Simba growing up in the jungle with Timon and Pumbaa
Chicken thighs marinated in peri peri of chilli, lemon, garlic and paprika, grilled until charred, with yellow rice.
W: South African malva pudding of apricot jam sponge baked at 180C for 40 minutes, soaked in a hot cream and butter sauce, with custard.
K: Watering hole peach rooibos iced tea
the watering hole on the savannah

Rooibos steeped with honey and orange peel, chilled and poured over ice with sliced ripe peach, fresh mint and a splash of sparkling water. Steep 4 rooibos tea bags and the peel of 1 orange in 1L just-boiled water for 8 minutes. Remove the bags and peel, stir in 3 tbsp honey and chill for at least 2 hours. Slice 2 ripe peaches. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and peach slices, pour in the tea to three quarters full and top each with a splash of sparkling water and a sprig of mint.

s.note: Timon and Pumbaa showing Simba the grubs
s.how: Heat oil to 190C and drop in small handfuls of dry rice vermicelli so they puff up instantly into crunchy grubs. Drain and toss with chilli flakes, sea salt and a squeeze of lime. Pile onto a leaf and dig in.

Cut a rockmelon, half a papaya and 2 mangoes into wedges and arrange on a platter with halved passionfruit. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a pinch of chilli salt. Serve on a hot day on the savanna.

m.note: Simba growing up in the jungle with Timon and Pumbaa
m.how: Blitz red chillies with lemon juice, garlic, smoked paprika, oil and salt into a peri peri sauce. Marinate 1kg chicken thighs for 2 hours and grill until charred. Cook long grain rice with a pinch of turmeric and serve together.

w.how: Beat 2 eggs with 200g sugar, add a spoon of apricot jam, then fold in 150g self-raising flour, 30g melted butter and 250ml milk. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Pour over hot sauce of 250ml cream, 100g butter and sugar. Serve with custard.
